description:
# Portrait two-column recovery fix 1.49.0-niconico.12

Fixes a confirmed detection gap in **Fix tablet home feed layout (experimental)**. The previous version required cell widths to be at most 40% of the viewport, unintentionally excluding portrait two-column layouts. It now recognizes cells up to 60% while retaining the large-screen, stable-mismatch and loop-prevention guards.

Verified from the user's live objects: FlowLayoutManager reports 2 columns; the normal cell is 753px in a 1584px viewport; an item with full-span=false has a stale 1528px view width. The old detector counted zero cells and never attempted recovery. Unit tests cover these exact values and retain the original three-column cases.

Update the existing source to `1.49.0-niconico.12` and keep **Fix tablet home feed layout (experimental)** plus **Feed layout diagnostics** selected. Keep the same original APK and other selections. Phone verification of the packaged two-column fix remains required. Empty native-ad placeholders are a separate case.
